reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-09-29 dashboard disclosure reported $134,692,762 of reserves against about $133.67M of thUSD supply: $98.72M gold carry and $35.85M thBILL, plus about $124k of redemption liquidity. USDT was $20,000 / $134,692,762, or 0.0148486%; the other three disclosed percentages remain at their published precision. The four authored slices total 100.0048486%, within the 0.5 percentage-point composition tolerance. The gold carry slice remains one position because its internal allocation is not disclosed. This review corrects precision in the September 29 snapshot, rather than replacing it with the September 30 dashboard composition.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Mint collateral is received by the 4-of-5 thUSD Cash Wallet Safe, and the strategy spreads custody across Standard Chartered/Libeara (gold side), a US-regulated Fortune-500 FCM holding CME margin in CFTC-segregated customer funds, and Wellington-managed Treasury funds. Provider share percentages, segregation, and rehypothecation terms are not published; the FCM is not named. Bankruptcy remoteness is structured at the MG999 fund level (gold outside lessee estates, insured and reinsured with a 20% first-loss buffer), not evidenced for every reserve leg.
